Specifications.What’s in the box:
Xbox Wireless Headset
USB-C charging cable (14 inches long)
Specifications.Microphones: Mic design: bendable boom with dual mics and Illuminated LED when mic is on
Specifications.Controls: Buttons: power/pair, mute, game/chat audio balance dial (left earcup), volume dial (right earcup).
Specifications.Battery: Internal, rechargeable lithium-ion battery with up to 15 hours of battery life per charge. 30 minutes of charging provides about 4 hours of battery life and recharges to full battery life in about 3 hours when headset is not in use.
Specifications.Virtual Surround Sound: Supports Spatial Sound technologies like Windows Sonic, Dolby Atmos, and DTS Headphone: X on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One
Specifications.Xbox Accessories app: Adjust equalizer settings, bass boost, auto-mute, LED brightness, and mic monitoring

Materials.Headband: inner steel metal band with foam cushioning
Materials.Ear cushions: oval design with polyurethane leather and foam cushioning

Speakers.Speaker material: Paper composite diaphragm and neodymium magnet

key_features: Easy to set up: No complex wires to your console. Wired only to the Wireless Controller
